selection_rule: Select the loosest prospectively tested tolerance that passes all 12 frozen Richards cases.
finding: A log(K) interpolation tolerance of 3e-4 is the first preregistered level that preserves all frozen F-AHL10 fidelity and nonlinear-path gates across B01, B12, O05 and O14 in wet, mid and dry regimes.
numerical_note: Completion required the F-AHL10C cancellation-stable but algebraically equivalent Mualem conductivity expression as the research table-construction oracle at the extreme dry end. The production B1.10 provider was not changed.
next_action: Measure constitutive and paired end-to-end runtime for the selected 3e-4 representation across the 12-case matrix before any broader application or production-oriented work.
nonclaims: The selected tolerance is qualified only for the tested materials, head regimes and prescribed-head lower boundary.
No whole-SWAP speedup is established by this matrix.
